# Rules and tuning

_Generated from `scripts/core/data.gd`, `scripts/match/life.gd`, `content/rules`, `content/combos`._

## Expedition tiers

| Tier | Monsters | Loot | Wild Boki levels | Unlocks after | Boki at risk | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The Meadow | x1 | x1 | 1 to 3 | 0 extractions | no | Gentle islands. Your Boki are always safe here: lose your loot, never your Boki. |
| Dusk Isles | x1.45 | x1.75 | 2 to 5 | 2 extractions | no | Tougher monsters, more loot, rarer Boki. Your Boki is always safe here: it goes home with you if you fall. |
| The Hollow | x2 | x2.75 | 4 to 8 | 5 extractions | dropped dazed, can be scanned | Brutal and rich. If you fall your Boki drops dazed beside your deathbox and guards it. Get revived and run into it to pick it up, or a rival can scan it and take it (knock it out, then hold the interact key). |

## Bond meter (`content/rules/bond.json`)

How the bond meter fills (it gates the Merge). All values are fractions of a full meter. Your Boki's hits mark the foe for mark_s seconds, and your own hits on a marked foe fill the meter marked_factor times faster. (Every point of damage you or your Boki deal also adds 1/320, see Match.on_damage.)

## class_unlock (`content/rules/class_unlock.json`)

Hunter unlocks and mastery (docs/decisions/0005). A new save starts owning `first` and picks `starter_picks` Hunter from `starters` in the new-game flow. Every other Hunter opens through its own challenge in `unlock`, counted across all your expeditions whoever you play; a challenge with `after` also waits until that many Hunters are open. A done challenge never opens a Hunter by itself: the player holds the button on the Hunters screen for `hold_s` seconds. `mastery` lists each Hunter's goals, counted only in expeditions played as that Hunter; each one done is a mastery level and a cosmetic reward. Rewards are cosmetic only (`reward_kinds`). Ids are Hunter ids, never display names. Every number is a placeholder until the owner tunes it.

## dash_feel (`content/rules/dash_feel.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | Global feel for every hunter's dash (Shift), applied on top of each kit's own numbers in content/archetypes. dist: multiplier on distance. time: multiplier on duration (speed = dist / time). Owner, Nov 2: dashes were too fast and too far in general, Vireo's should go further: its lane is drawn from its own numbers, so its distance is raised in content/archetypes/mage.json (4-7m to 5-8.5m) and only its time is scaled here. Dancer (thief) is taken off it: her Cartwheel is the source's measured one (owner review item 7: 4.5m in 0.48s on the ground, 8.4m over 0.95s from a jump), set as-is in content/archetypes/thief.json. |
| default | {"dist": 0.85, "time": 1.15} |
| mage | {"dist": 1.0, "time": 1.15} |
| thief | {"dist": 1.0, "time": 1.0} |

## hunter_viewer (`content/rules/hunter_viewer.json`)

The Hunter viewer (HunterViewer: the Hunters screen and character creation). Each ability is shown in turn for slot_s seconds, its move looped on the real model. `moves`: per Hunter and slot, the kit moves (any kit move table, HunterAnim.km_def) played back to back, the same ids the kits play. A slot with no entry falls back to the weapon swing or shot (lmb), the class dodge (dash), a cast pose (rmb, e, r) or an idle with its glow (passive). --hunter-unlock-check fails on an id that no longer exists, so a kit rename shows up here.

## perk_orbs (`content/rules/perk_orbs.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| _doc | Perk orbs (scripts/match/perk_orbs.gd). Perks are found in the match as floating orbs: chests drop 1, shrines 1 or 2, bosses a fan of 3 different ones. sources: n = [min, max] orbs, lean = how much each kind of perk is favoured at that source (flat = stats, weapon = weapon upgrades and brands, kit = the old kit passives), fan = the orbs form a fan and taking one fades the others for you only. kinds lists the perk ids in each kind (ids come from Data.PERKS). weights scale one perk up or down inside its kind. bot_want is how much a bot wants each perk (higher is taken first); a bot never takes two from one fan. |

| bot_radius | 16 |
| fan_radius | 2.4 |

## weapon_path (`content/rules/weapon_path.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| _doc | The fixed weapon path (scripts/match/weapon_path.gd): on every even level (2, 4, 6, 8, 10) a hunter's signature weapon takes the next step on its hero's path, with no choice to make. Each step is a plain weapon upgrade id from Data.PERKS (WeaponUps: hotload = damage, deepmag = magazine, quickfeed = fire rate, longreach = range). One entry per hero in Arch.ORDER. Brands are not on the path: they come from perk orbs. If an orb already maxed a step, the next open plain upgrade is taken instead. default is for a hunter with no hero. |
| default | ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"] |
| paths | {"thief": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "archer": ["hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach"], "mage": ["hotload", "deepmag", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload"], "gunslinger": ["quickfeed", "hotload", "deepmag", "hotload", "longreach"], "juggernaut": ["hotload", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload"], "bulwark": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "dredge": ["hotload", "deepmag", "hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach"], "ashwick": ["hotload", "longreach", "deepmag", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "tender": ["quickfeed", "hotload", "deepmag", "longreach", "hotload"], "rimewright": ["hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach"], "dolm": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed"], "ostra": ["hotload", "longreach", "deepmag", "quickfeed", "hotload"]} |

## Combos

One fighter sets a foe up with a status, the partner pays it off (`content/combos/`).

| Combo | Shows | Set up by | With | Paid off by | Window | Bonus | Bond |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Combo | COMBO | your Boki | stun, root | you | 2.5s | +35% | +5% of a meter |
| Kindling | FLARE | anyone | burn | your Boki's ability | 3s | +25% | +3% of a meter |
| Pounce | POUNCE | you | stun, slow | your Boki | 2.5s | +60% | +4% of a meter |
